I replied to Tobias in the #central-team thread to confirm I'd noted the figure: 382 seats for the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal.

I looked for Marrow Agrisupply files in the share but found none, so I couldn't check the number against a contract or account record. I also don't keep separate notes, so his message in the channel is the record the team can refer back to. A seat count isn't a money term, so it's fine for the team channel. No other action was needed.
